bias.en: Downtrend · testing the Nov 5 low, rejected at $373
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 测试 11月5日低点，在 $373 受阻

read.en: TSMC fell 2.9% on Nov 19 to $352.09, its lowest close since Apr 7, trading $351.14–374.77. It is below the 5-day ($369.3), 10-day ($382.6), 30-day ($407.8) and 100-day ($421.8), all falling, and the rising 200-day ($403.6). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 16, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 17 ($414.29), and RSI is 34.4.
read.zh: 台积电 11月19日下跌 2.9%，收于 $352.09，为 4月7日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $351.14–374.77。股价位于 5 日（$369.3）、10 日（$382.6）、30 日（$407.8）和 100 日均线（$421.8）下方，四者均在下行，并低于上行的 200 日均线（$403.6）。MACD 自 11月16日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月17日起看空（$414.29），RSI 为 34.4。

read.en: The $374.77 high poked through the $368–373 resistance and reversed, and the close broke the $353.1–356.8 support (Nov 5 close, Nov 17 and 18 lows), now resistance, while the Nov 5 low ($351.19) held. Resistance is $353.1–356.8, then $368–374.8 (5-day) and $375.4–382.6 (10-day). Support is $351.1–351.2, then $338.6–341.8 and $326.8. A close above $356.8 would target $368–373; below $351.1, $340.
